---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement or new capability
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem

What problem would this solve? Who is affected?

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature or change you would like to see.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about, and why they are less suitable.

## Scope and constraints

- Does this change the JSON API contract?
- Does it need a new dependency or migration?
- Is it local-only compatible (no auth/network exposure assumptions)?

## Additional context

Mockups, example payloads or links are welcome. v1 is intentionally local-only; features that
require network exposure should note the auth/CSRF work in [PLAN.md](../../PLAN.md).
